data.why: test_data/ already ships synthetic Kea and Tecmag CPMG/T1/T2-D datasets with known true values, and the page's own 'Explore test data' button loads them directly; nothing needs to be written.

goals: load a CPMG echo-train dataset and inspect the raw echoes and summed decay before fitting
run a multi-exponential fit (1-4 components) on the T2 decay and read off amplitudes, T2 values and fit statistics (AIC/BIC, reduced chi-squared)
run an inverse Laplace transform (ILT) on the decay and compare it against the multi-exponential fit
quantify uncertainty on the fitted parameters with MCMC or bootstrap and get credible/percentile intervals
run a spatially resolved (FT) analysis to see T2(z), amplitude(z) and ILT spectra across position
run a T2-D correlation analysis (SSE-T2 data) and check which part of the T2-D map the data can actually resolve

review.summary: The CPMG path is captured well: the phases follow the real load → fit → uncertainty → position-resolved → export stages, the labels are faithful, and all 14 screens I opened show what their nodes claim. It should not be filed as is: the T2–D and T1Sat analyses are missing (T2–D is a stated goal and the README's most stressed feature), the bootstrap feature is lumped into the comparison table, and the uncertainty tasks don't say they ran on a 3-component fit.
